_read_me: Robot 4, Moonshot (stocks). Matthew 2026-11-04: 'a new bot that is all high risk high reward'. Practice money only, never Moomoo. All in on the 2 hottest climbers (biggest 10-day rise, above their 20-day average) from wild stocks and 2-3x leveraged funds; sells on a 15% trailing stop or when it stops climbing. Checked hourly in market hours. Costs: $0 commission (like Wealthsimple/Questrade/National Bank) plus 0.1% slippage; currency conversion is NOT modelled. Not backtested: a live experiment.
